ai_summary.text:
マルマエは半導体製造装置用の精密金属部品の加工を主力とするメーカーで、真空チャンバー部品やガス供給部品の精密切削加工を手がけている。半導体エッチング装置やCVD装置に使用される高精度なアルミ・ステンレスの精密部品を受託加工しており、半導体製造装置メーカーとの直接取引で安定した受注基盤を構築している。

売上114億円（前年比+140.1%）と大幅な増収を達成。営業利益21億円（営業利益率18.4%）と非常に高い利益率を実現し、純利益14億円。半導体製造装置の需要急回復が業績を大きく押し上げた。ROE16.6%と高い資本効率を達成。

自己資本比率32.1%とやや低い水準だが、財務健全性スコア75点。営業CF31億円だがFCFマイナス66億円は大規模な設備投資による成長投資が主因。EPS107円に対しPER15.1倍、配当40円で配当性向は約37%。半導体製造装置の構造的な需要拡大が精密加工品の中長期的な成長を支え、高い利益率と積極的な設備投資が成長フェーズの企業姿勢を示している。
ai_summary.text_en: Marumae is a precision metal components processor for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, specializing in precision cutting of vacuum chamber parts and gas supply components. The company provides high-precision aluminum and stainless steel parts used in semiconductor etching and CVD equipment through subcontract processing, establishing a stable order base through direct relationships with semiconductor equipment manufacturers.  Sales of  11.4 billion (+140.1% YoY) achieved substantial growth. Operating profit of  2.1 billion (18.4% margin) realized exceptionally high profitability with net income of  1.4 billion. Sharp recovery in semiconductor equipment demand significantly boosted performance. ROE of 16.6% achieved strong capital efficiency.  Equity ratio of 32.1% is somewhat low though financial health score of 75 points is solid. Operating CF of  3.1 billion versus negative FCF of  6.6 billion reflects major capital investment for growth. EPS of  107 versus PER of 15.1x; dividend of  40 represents approximately 37% payout ratio. Structural demand expansion for semiconductor manufacturing equipment supports medium to long-term growth in precision processing, while high profit margins and aggressive capital investment demonstrate the company's growth-phase posture.
